subject: Mechanical Engineering
title: Grashof's Law: Will It Rotate Fully?
description: A micro-lesson that makes Grashof's Law: Will It Rotate Fully? usable.

hook.text: Not every four-bar linkage can complete a full rotation. A simple rule tells.

buildup.text: Grashof says: add the shortest and longest links and compare to the other two.

discovery.text: If the sum of shortest plus longest is less, full rotation is possible.

twist.text: Violate the rule and no link can rotate fully — all just rock back and forth.

climax.text: Designers check Grashof before building. It prevents stuck mechanisms.

punchline.text: Four lengths and one rule decide if it spins or rocks.

quiz.question: What does Grashof's law determine for a four-bar linkage?
options: How fast the mechanism can operate safely
Whether any link can make a full rotation based on link lengths
The force required to drive the mechanism
